title: InventoryStateMessage
description: The receiving session's actor's whole inventory, as the server holds it at `tick`. Sent once right after SESSION_READY and again in every tick in which that actor's inventory changed - for MINE_RESOURCE, in the same tick as and after its COMMAND_RESULT (spec p1-02 section 5.1a). It is a full state, not a delta: a client that missed one needs nothing but the next. THE CLIENT NEVER COMPUTES AN INVENTORY (spec p1-02 I-49): what it shows is always the last INVENTORY_STATE. Inventory belongs to the actor, not the ship (ADR-0013 section 1). No capacity: there is no carry limit in p1-02 (design doc section 2.4).

actor_id.description: Owner. Always the receiving session's actor.

items.description: One entry per mineral the actor holds, in ascending mineral_id order. A mineral with 0 kg has no entry. Empty array = empty inventory.
